svg.title: Where the edges come from during job expansion
svg.desc: ChainAfterLastEntityEvent chains events that touch the same garage asset; OrderAfterJobLeafEvents orders events within one job; tray moves into a bay depend on that bay's last event.
svg.metadata: ["Start: job 0 retrieves the payload on T17 into bay B21, which still holds the empty tray T21. The DAG is empty and last_event_by_entity has no entries.", "Event 0, BayTransition B21 -> TO_RETRIEVE. Rule A finds no earlier B21 event and rule B finds no earlier leaf of job 0, so no edge is added. last_event_by_entity[B21] = 0.", "Event 1 moves T21 out of the bay (destination still open). Rule B: event 0 is a leaf of job 0, so 0 -> 1. last_event_by_entity[T21] = 1.", "Event 2 moves T17 into B21. Rule B: the only job-0 leaf is now event 1, so 1 -> 2. Rule C: the destination is a bay, so the move waits for the bay's last event: 0 -> 2.", "Event 3, BayTransition B21 -> PROCESS_RETRIEVE. Rule A chains it to B21's last event (0 -> 3); rule B adds 2 -> 3. last_event_by_entity[B21] = 3.", "Job 1 reparks T21 to P24 (event 4). Rule B finds no leaf of job 1, so it adds nothing; rule A links it to T21's last event: 1 -> 4. That shared tray is the only link between the two jobs."]

g.text: Each Expand<Type>Job adds an event, then calls one or both PlanContext helpers. Rule C is OrderAfterBayAndChargerEvents, called by ExpandReparkTrayJob. The letters A,

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: B, C are this guide's names, not the code's. The result is a partial order, not a sequence.
